verdict.rationale: OneDrive/Graph documents a driveItem search API (`/search(q='...')`) that searches an item hierarchy or drive, which in practice indexes file content, not just filenames, but the evidence pack never explicitly states full-text content indexing or contrasts it with prefix-only matching. Missing for 10: explicit documentation confirming content-body indexing/full-text search scope, file-type coverage limits, and independent/hands-on confirmation that search returns content matches beyond filenames.
